newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Corrugated board drags on KNP BT Packaging profits.
newsitem.headline: Corrugated board drags on KNP BT Packaging profits.

text.p: Dutch paper and packaging group KNP BT said on Wednesday operating results at its packaging arm had been hit by poor performance at its corrugated board paper unit RP Europe.
The group earlier reported operating profit at its packaging activities had fallen to 55 million guilders in the fourth quarter from a year-earlier 70 million.
"This result was negatively affected by...RP Europe...which had to contend with a temporary distortion in supply and demand in the corrugated board paper market," KNP BT said.
It said graphic and packaging board performed well.

It said its flexible and protective packaging activities had also yielded good results. The company announced last month it was hiving off its worldwide plastic packaging operations to Tenneco Packaging of the U.S.
Full-year sales at KNP BT Packaging amounted to 3.0 billion guilders last year, down from 4.0 billion in 1995. The reduction was mainly due to divestments, it said.

Operating profits declined to 261 million guilders from a year-earlier 275 million, but excluding acquisitions and divestments the sector operating result would have risen by 10 million guilders, KNP BT said.
